title: Dolly photo
description: One picture fills the frame: it opens with a diagonal mask led by a gold edge of light, the camera dollies in from wide and keeps drifting slowly; the title and one line slide in on a soft band of shade, on the side away from a face.

props.src: required, a photo or an mp4 of the user's own
props.title: a large line on the picture, 1-8 words
props.side: left, right or bottom: where the words go (default: away from the face, else bottom)
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of a face, 0 to 1
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the person
props.gold: words of the title to colour gold

example.alt: A round table by the window
example.title: A seat by the window
